blocks.content: 暴雨夜，悬崖攀岩壁，闪电劈开乌云。
blocks.imagePrompt:
Subject: a sheer wet granite sea-cliff climbing wall at night, vertical route of bolted anchors, quickdraws, a taut static rope and chalk-marked holds, one tiny adult climber silhouette for scale, contemporary mountaineering kit on an enormous rock face
Environment: torrential rain at night on a coastal cliff, black storm clouds split by volumetric lightning, churning sea spray far below, fresh fracture lines and loose scree on the overhanging upper rock, cold steel-blue darkness pressing in
Composition: wide establishing frame, eye level, facing the cliff, full depth readable from foreground wet stone to storm sky above, climber a thumbnail in the lower third, the overhanging upper wall mass looming over them
Lighting: lightning backlight stabbing through driving rain, hard rim light on wet granite, cold steel-blue and slate-grey palette, deep black shadows in cracks, a single neon-red glow from a wrist device bleeding red across the stone
Material: slick rain-sheeting granite, beaded rope fibers, machined steel hardware, smeared chalk paste, water pooling on ledges, rock dust and rubble trembling loose
Mood: hyperreal disaster dread, adrenaline and looming collapse, icy, breathless, catastrophic

blocks.content: 登山者单手悬挂在岩点，腕上NOVA表盘显示心率180。
blocks.imagePrompt:
Subject: adult female climber hanging one-handed from a single granite crimp, body taut and twisting, other arm slack at her side, jaw clenched mid-gasp, adult woman in a soaked technical shell and harness
Environment: sheer sea cliff face at night, torrential rain, churning black ocean far below, low clouds split by lightning above the rock
Composition: medium close shot from below looking up past her straining forearm toward the sky, shallow depth of field, subject sharp against blurred rain and rock
Lighting: cold steel-blue and slate-grey volumetric lightning backlight rimming her silhouette, hard shadows, one small neon-red glow rising from the watch dial
Material: wet skin beaded with rain, slick dark granite, soaked synthetic shell fabric, water streaking the watch glass
Mood: hyperreal disaster tension, cold steel-blue and slate-grey palette punctured by a single red accent

camera.shotDescription: Push in tight on the NOVA watch face as the climber hangs one-handed, letting the 180 bpm readout land amid the storm.

blocks.content: 表盘突然弹出红色预警：山体位移，滑坡倒计时00:12。
blocks.imagePrompt:
Subject: adult woman climber, chalked hands, one arm hooked on a granite crimp, drenched hair plastered to her cheek, exhausted open-mouthed gasp, eyes locked on the watch strapped to her raised wrist
Environment: vertical cliff face at night in a torrential rainstorm, slick wet rock streaked with runoff, black clouds torn open by lightning above, distant churning sea far below, loose scree and fractured slabs trembling on the upper wall
Composition: medium close-up, low angle looking up past her arm, watch face held sharp in foreground focus, climber's face soft, cliff wall and sky dissolving into rain-blurred depth
Lighting: cold steel-blue lightning backlight rimming her silhouette, hard flash freezing raindrops mid-air, slate-grey ambient gloom, one neon-red glow spilling from the watch dial onto her wet skin and knuckles
Material: slick polished granite sheen, soaked technical shell fabric and harness webbing, beaded water on skin, scratched metal watch bezel, glowing glass dial with hairline cracks
Mood: hyperreal disaster dread, breath-held tension, cold desaturated palette broken by a single alarm-red pulse

blocks.content: 她抬头，整片岩壁正从上方崩塌。
blocks.imagePrompt:
Subject: adult woman climber, soaked and breathless, one arm hooked on a granite hold, head tilted back, eyes wide, harness and chalk bag on her hips, NOVA watch on her wrist flashing a red warning.
Environment: vertical granite cliff face at night in torrential rain, storm clouds split by lightning above, a whole section of the wall shearing loose overhead, loose rock and dust hurtling down past her, black valley far below.
Composition: low-angle medium shot from just under her, framed past her shoulder toward the collapsing wall above, shallow depth of field, her face sharp, tumbling debris falling soft behind.
Lighting: volumetric lightning backlight ripping through rain, cold steel-blue and slate-grey wash on wet stone, single neon-red glow from the watch underlighting her jaw.
Material: slick wet granite streaked with runoff, soaked technical shell fabric and webbing, chalk paste on her palm, sheeting rain, airborne rock dust and spray.
Mood: hyperreal disaster dread, cold desaturated palette broken by one red pulse, raw exposure and vertigo.
